title: Illumination
description: The demo scene of Illumination, a forward-shading lighting library for Defold: point and spot lights, a flashlight, fog, normal and specular maps, walked in first person.
author: Roman Silin (astrochili)
controls: WASD move, Shift run, Space jump, C crouch, E flashlight, F spectator mode, mouse look.
credits: Textures from Tiny Texture Pack 1 and 2 by Screaming Brain Studios.
Specular and normal maps generated with Normal Map Online by @cpetry.
